title: tc-prompt-starters
description: Suggestions for an empty chat and follow-ups after an answer, as a list that fills the composer or sends.

heading.description: The heading above the list, and the list's accessible name

variant.description: "starters" for an empty chat (icon tiles and hints), or "follow-ups" after an answer (compact rows)

groups.description: Suggestions in groups, each with a heading and an icon

items.description: Suggestions without groups – shown after any groups

mode.description: What choosing a suggestion does unless it says otherwise: "send" it, or "fill" the composer to edit first

loading.description: The suggestions are being worked out: placeholder rows instead of the list

hints.description: Show the key hints under the list (↵ and →)

sendLabel.description: The word for sending in the key hint and the screen-reader text

fillLabel.description: The word for filling the composer in the key hint and the screen-reader text

emptyText.description: Text when there are no suggestions (and not loading); empty hides the element's list entirely

icon.description: The icon its suggestions show unless they have their own

tone.description: The tint of its icon tiles

PromptStarterTone.description: A tone for a group's icon tiles

text.description: What's sent, or put in the composer

label.description: What the row shows, when shorter than the text – defaults to the text

hint.description: A lighter line after the label, e.g. where the suggestion comes from: “From your last report”

icon.description: A built-in icon's name or an Element (cloned) – defaults to the group's

mode.description: Overrides the list's `mode` for this suggestion – "fill" for prompts with a blank to complete

PromptStarterMode.description: What choosing a suggestion does: send it as it is, or put it in the composer to edit first
